scenes.narration: This synthetic deck demonstrates deterministic localization without using private presentation content.

scenes.narration: The base deck keeps layout and timing. Locale overlays keep only translated strings and a hash of the source text they were extracted from.

scenes.body: Start with a canonical deck, create a same-structure translated copy, extract the overlay, and then render any locale from the canonical deck. When the source text changes, the overlay refuses to apply until it is refreshed.
scenes.narration: The workflow is intentionally deterministic. A translated copy is used to extract an overlay, and later renders do not need another model call.
